purpose: Dated navigational registry for source discovery. Listing a source does not mean all rules on that page have been verified or are applicable to every member, provider, county, service, or plan.

sources.title: Behavioral HealthChoices
sources.scope_note: Re-verified live 2026-10-13: content unchanged since 2026-10-10. Overview states counties contract with an MCO for MH/D&A services; counties must ensure high-quality, timely access and coordination; each consumer is assigned a BH-MCO by county of residence and chooses providers within the BH-MCO network; participating providers accepting new clients are member-accessible. Page states no provider network status, benefits, or rates. Dated snapshot: docs/source-snapshots/bhc-overview-2026-10-13.md

sources.title: Behavioral HealthChoices: Information for Providers
sources.scope_note: Re-verified live 2026-10-12. Provider-facing overview: county contracts with MCO; county MH programs ensure quality/timely access; BH-MCO assigned by county of residence; eligibles map shows 2,717,158 lives covered statewide by zone/county/MCO (map uses 'MBH' label where directory says Magellan — reconcile before use); ASAM rate schedule headed 'Rates Effective January 1, 2026'; HCBS gap payments ledger present. Provider acceptance, per-case benefits, and exact rates NOT established. Dated snapshot: docs/source-snapshots/bhc-providers-2026-10-12.md

sources.title: Behavioral HealthChoices: Managed Care Organizations
sources.scope_note: Use as a dated county-to-BH-MCO lookup. Dated snapshot of the full county mapping preserved at docs/source-snapshots/bhc-mcos-2026-10-12.md (re-verified live 2026-10-12: five BH-MCOs — Community Behavioral Health (Philadelphia, 1 county), Community Care Behavioral Health Organization (41 counties), Magellan Behavioral Health of Pennsylvania (7 counties), PerformCare (7 counties), Carelon Health of PA (11 counties) — covering PA's 67 counties exactly once; page structure unchanged since 2026-10-10). A county mapping alone does not establish provider credentialing, open network status, benefits, or reimbursement.

sources.title: Behavioral HealthChoices Publications
sources.scope_note: Re-verified live 2026-10-11: index lists General Publications (PSR + appendices, ASAM rates effective Jan 1 2026, 2026 FRR, HealthChoices examination guides, TiPS, OMHSAS Member Handbook 2026), OMHSAS parity/other reports, NCQA/URAC certification note (42 CFR 438.332), and EQR technical reports (statewide 2015-2023; Carelon/CBH/CCBH/Magellan 2015-2023). Index page only — open each linked document and record its version/effective date before encoding anything.

sources.title: Behavioral HealthChoices Systems Management
sources.issuer: Pennsylvania Department of Human Services / OMHSAS
sources.scope_note: Official OMHSAS systems page re-verified live 2026-10-12: Systems Management owns state systems operations, claim/encounter-data management, and behavioral-health business intelligence; page indexes systems notices (newest OMHSAS-2026-001, 2026-06-09), EDI companion guides/file layouts (837, 834, 277, 999, BES, ESC, PRV435/PRV720), per-BH-MCO EDV studies (2023) and on-site reviews (2023, 2019), and Provider Type 07 capitation enrollment forms. Page-level only; study PDFs not read; files nonpublic. Dated snapshot docs/source-snapshots/bhc-systems-management-2026-10-12.md. Not evidence that nonpublic data are available to this project.

sources.title: Medicaid Managed Care Rate Review and Rate Guides

Current guide is the 2026-2027 Medicaid Managed Care Rate Development Guide (released Feb 2026) for rating periods starting July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027; page is the index of federal guides, not the guides themselves and not a PA rate/rule source. sources.title: Request Behavioral HealthChoices Program Services
sources.scope_note: Member-facing explanation of access routes (county mental-health office, BH-MCO assignment by county of residence, member handbook, provider choice within the BH-MCO network), Medicaid application channels (COMPASS, CAO, mail, phone), and crisis help (988). Not a benefit specification, provider contract, rate document, or enrollment record.
